text_block_list.text:
Though our summer training camp concludes here,
my fighting spirit burns even more brightly now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: After all, she's definitely built up her strength heading into the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: Now all that's left is the real thing!

text_block_list.text: Yes, as long as I can maintain my current form, I should be able to win.
